MULTIPLICITY_IS_THE_CENTRAL_RISK.declared_now: the headline reporting cell is latency=50ms, cost=0.25c, budget=10%, POLICY_INDUCED_ONLY, protection=REDUCING_SIDE_PROTECTION -- fixed HERE, before any cell exists, so it cannot be chosen afterwards. The protection coordinate is per R-177.
MULTIPLICITY_IS_THE_CENTRAL_RISK.ruling_requested: THE GRID CHARACTERIZES A SURFACE; IT DOES NOT SELECT A CELL.
MULTIPLICITY_IS_THE_CENTRAL_RISK.why: 1512 cells searched for the best one manufactures a positive with effective certainty -- the amendment DOUBLED the surface, so the no-selection rule matters more, not less. No Phase-4 conclusion may be stated as 'at the best cell'. Conclusions must be REGION properties -- monotone in latency, sign-stable across the cost grid up to X, holding under BOTH fill models AND both protection modes -- or not stated.

R165_bindings.fill_model_bracket: MANDATORY. REFERENCE_FILLS (queue-optimistic) and NO_FILLS (pessimistic) both run. A conclusion must hold under BOTH; a SIGN FLIP ACROSS THE BRACKET IS A FAIL, NOT A CHOICE (R-165(2) item 2).
R165_bindings.generation_tranche_tables: Phase 4 consumes generation-level tranche tables as `generation_table` produces (R-165(2) item 5). ANY cell consuming the 1s-capped per-row latency labels MUST declare the cap as part of its estimand.

reduce_shares_cancel_budget.note: R-165(2) item 4: a venue-semantics assumption, priced in the protocol, not baked into the machine. Declared FALSE here; reduces keep separate counters.

R165_bindings.reset_cost_primary: POLICY_INDUCED_ONLY — the metric is DIFFERENTIAL vs the reference trajectory and reference-coincident generation starts are common-mode; charging them taxes the policy for events it did not cause. CHARGE_EVERY_REPOST runs as an ablation. EVERY receipt NAMES which cell it reports (R-165(2) item 1).

consumes: forward or development tape as declared per run; NO Phase-4 cell may be read on tape reserved for forward validation of a frozen candidate.

grid.cost_grid_rationale: brackets the measured gross break-even from BELOW to well above: TODO §7 implies btc 0.29/0.38/0.32c and eth 0.011/0.068/0.072c per cancellation at 5/10/15%. The grid spans 0 to 2.00c — ~6x above btc's break-even and ~28x above eth's — so the sign change is INSIDE the grid for both coins rather than off its edge.
grid.protection_mode_semantics: REDUCING_SIDE_PROTECTION is the TODO's PRIMARY rule: the harm score may override any live generation on the threatened side, but inventory-REDUCING orders are protected explicitly. ALL_ORDERS_OVERRIDE is the explicit ABLATION in which the score may cancel a reducing order too. Both run; every receipt NAMES which mode it reports. Per TODO §6 this must be an explicit RULE and an explicit ABLATION -- not a default buried in the machine.

per_cell_reporting: gross avoided harm, favorable-fill sacrifice, cost-adjusted value
cancellations per minute and per generation
hold duration, repost count, queue resets
fill and share retention, spread capture
terminal inventory, peak inventory, reducing vs increasing split
comparison vs QR_SKEW_ONLY, QR_CANCEL_HOLD_X_SKEW, and matched random on identical opportunities
per-hour concentration (top-hour share, positive-without-best-hour) — added by BE: the Phase-2 gate showed an aggregate net can be half one hour

score_source.note: Primary input is the frozen reduced-fine score. If the user approves freeze-B, PLUS_PRED_STATE_V1 slots in HERE without redrafting the protocol; the grid, bars and reporting list are unchanged by which score is fed. Each Phase-4 receipt names the score_source it consumed.

bars.holds_under_both_protection_modes: sign(value|REDUCING_SIDE_PROTECTION) == sign(value|ALL_ORDERS_OVERRIDE); a conclusion that depends on being allowed to cancel inventory-reducing orders is a DIFFERENT claim and must be stated as one
bars.material_retention: fill_retention >= 0.5 (declared; below this the policy is not market-making, it is withdrawal)
bars.no_net_cents_as_profit: a receipt claiming profit must show reset/repost costs AND complete lifecycle included (TODO §7 closing line)
bars.sign_stable_over_cost_region: value > 0 for every cost cell at or below the coin's measured break-even
